title: Ceramics
description: Powder pressed and fired until its grains grow together: dense, hard, and fine-grained if done well. Unlocks the Sintering Press.

puzzle.goal: A pressed part of mass m fills a volume V; the solid itself has density r. Write the share p of full density reached.
puzzle.name: Relative density
puzzle.ask: Find p for m = @{m} g, V = @{V} cm³ and r = @{r} g/cm³ (alumina).
puzzle.method: Fully dense, the part would weigh V·r; what it weighs over that is how dense it is.
